characters.name: Sword Knight
characters.look: a young woman with deep brown skin and short black natural hair, in silver plate armor over a royal-blue tabard, gripping a broadsword taller than she is.
characters.attack: a huge two-handed overhead slash, the blade sweeping down in front of her.
characters.recoil: staggers backward, the sword's tip dragging on the ground.

characters.name: Star Mage
characters.look: a young man with pale, freckled skin, messy copper-orange hair and round glasses, in a navy wizard hat and robe dotted with gold stars, holding a staff twice his height topped with a glowing cyan crystal.
characters.attack: thrusts the staff forward with both hands, the crystal flaring bright cyan.
characters.recoil: stumbles back, one hand holding his hat on.

characters.name: Gauntlet Brawler
characters.look: a young woman with warm medium-brown skin, wearing a teal sport hijab and a white-and-orange martial-arts outfit, with huge iron gauntlets as big as her torso.
characters.attack: a lunging punch, one giant gauntlet thrown straight out in front of her.
characters.recoil: skids back with both gauntlets raised to guard her face.

characters.name: Hammer Tinker
characters.look: a stocky older man with light-brown skin, a thick gray beard and brass goggles pushed up on his forehead, in a leather apron over a mustard-yellow work shirt, carrying an enormous brass-headed hammer.
characters.attack: a big overhead hammer smash in front of him.
characters.recoil: rocks back on his heels, the hammer head thudding down behind him.

characters.name: Wind Lancer
characters.look: an androgynous young adult with light skin and a straight black bob haircut, in a green hooded cloak with a long scarf, wielding a spear twice their height with a leaf-shaped blade.
characters.attack: a long forward lunge, the spear thrust straight out.
characters.recoil: pushed back, cloak and scarf whipping forward, spear tilted up.

characters.name: Byte Bot
characters.look: a small, round white-and-cyan robot with stubby arms and legs and a screen for a face showing two big pixel eyes, holding an oversized sword whose glowing cyan blade is shaped like a computer mouse-pointer arrow.
characters.attack: a wide horizontal sword swing.
characters.recoil: knocked back, the screen-face showing X eyes.

characters.name: Kobold
characters.look: a small green lizard-folk with two little horns, a long tail and a brown vest and belt, carrying a giant soup ladle bigger than itself over one shoulder.
characters.attack: whacks the giant ladle down in front of it.
characters.recoil: stumbles back, tail curled, the ladle wobbling.

characters.name: Animated Broom
characters.look: a straw broom with a long wooden handle, a scowling face with angry eyebrows on its bristles, and two tiny black legs.
characters.attack: swings its bristle end forward in a big sweeping whack.
characters.recoil: bends backward like a bow, bristles splayed out.

characters.name: Awakened Shrub
characters.look: a round, lumpy, leafy green bush with small angry eyes and a frown, wielding a thick thorny branch like a club.
characters.attack: lunges and swings the thorny branch.
characters.recoil: squashed backward, leaves ruffled.

characters.name: Crawling Claw
characters.look: a small brick-red crab-like creature with a ridged, segmented shell on its back, beady black eyes, six spindly legs and one oversized pincer.
characters.attack: scuttles forward snapping the giant pincer.
characters.recoil: flipped halfway onto its back, legs flailing.

characters.name: Pixie
characters.look: a tiny fairy with bright orange hair, pointed ears, pale-cyan dragonfly wings, a green tunic and brown boots, carrying a giant double-headed battle axe with a red heart painted on the blade.
characters.attack: a huge overhead axe chop.
characters.recoil: tumbles backward in the air, wings fluttering.

characters.name: Stirge
characters.look: a round, tangerine-orange blob of a creature with big cute eyes, feathery gray wings and a long, sharp needle of a nose.
characters.attack: dives forward, needle-nose first.
characters.recoil: bounced back, wings flapping wildly.

characters.name: Goblin
characters.look: a green-skinned goblin with huge pointed ears, a tuft of dark hair and a toothy grin, in a ragged green shirt and brown trousers, gripping a spiked wooden club as big as itself.
characters.attack: a big two-handed club swing.
characters.recoil: knocked back, ears flopping, club drooping.

characters.name: Evil Duck
characters.look: a stout slate-gray duck with narrowed, angry eyes, a smug scowl and an oversized, gleaming, sharp orange bill.
characters.attack: lunges forward stabbing with its bill, wings flared.
characters.recoil: knocked back, feathers ruffled.

characters.name: Skeleton
characters.look: a chibi skeleton with a big round skull, dark hollow eye sockets and a grin, its bones shaded gray-blue, swinging an oversized rusty sword.
characters.attack: a wide forward slash.
characters.recoil: rattles backward, jaw dropped open.

characters.name: Flumph
characters.look: a floating sky-blue jellyfish-like creature with a glossy round dome, big sparkly eyes, a sweet smile and dangling aqua tentacles, gripping an oversized golden trident in two tentacles.
characters.attack: bobs forward and jabs the big trident ahead of it.
characters.recoil: bounced back, tentacles trailing, dome dented.

characters.name: Flying Sword
characters.look: a steel broadsword with a pale-blue blade, a brown leather-wrapped hilt, a cute round-eyed face on the blade and a little white cloud puff at each end, hovering tip-first.
characters.attack: spins and stabs forward, point first.
characters.recoil: knocked back, tilting tip-up, eyes squeezed shut.

characters.name: Pseudodragon
characters.look: a cat-sized mint-green dragon with two small horns, big amber eyes, little bat wings with cyan veins, a cream belly and a curling tail, hugging a giant spiked tail-club.
characters.attack: a big club swing, wings flared.
characters.recoil: tumbles back, wings crumpled, tail drooping.

characters.name: Sentient Scarecrow
characters.look: a patchy straw scarecrow with a floppy brown hat with a yellow flower, button eyes, a stitched grin, an orange patched shirt, a rope belt and straw poking from its sleeves, carrying a giant pitchfork.
characters.attack: lurches forward, thrusting the pitchfork out.
characters.recoil: staggers back, straw puffing from its sleeves, hat askew.

characters.name: Haunted Lantern
characters.look: a dark-iron hanging lantern with a ring and short chain on top, glass panes glowing warm gold, a little smiling orange flame-face inside and two stubby legs, swinging a giant iron hook.
characters.attack: swings forward, bashing with the big hook.
characters.recoil: rocks back, chain jangling, the flame shrunk small.

characters.name: Swamp Dragon
characters.look: a small, round, olive-green dragon with a pale-blue belly, big hazel eyes, a lumpy ridged back, a stubby tail and oversized jaws full of tiny teeth.
characters.attack: lunges forward with the huge jaws chomping, a short orange flame burst at its mouth.
characters.recoil: tumbles back, tail in the air, a tiny puff of smoke from its nose.

characters.name: Rust Monster
characters.look: a round, rust-brown monster with a lumpy pitted hide, small dark eyes, a big toothy mouth, stubby legs and two giant segmented, ridged claws.
characters.attack: swings a giant claw forward in a crushing slam.
characters.recoil: knocked back, hide flaking, claws drooping.

characters.name: Origami Dragon
characters.look: a sleek paper dragon folded from orange-and-cream paper, with sharp crease lines, a long folded tail, a pointed snout, two angular horns and huge razor-edged folded wings.
characters.attack: lunges forward slashing with a wing-blade.
characters.recoil: crumples back, creased and wrinkled, wings folded.

characters.name: Possessed Painting
characters.look: a dark-haired man with a wide eerie smile in a dark suit, stepping out of a wooden picture frame as flat as a cutout, with long thin arms and a huge fencing foil.
characters.attack: lunges, one thin arm thrusting the giant foil forward.
characters.recoil: knocked back, the frame tilted crooked, eyes wide.

characters.name: Yarn Elemental
characters.look: a round, squishy bundle of orange yarn with a happy face, tiny arms, a yarn topknot, a trailing strand and a teal stripe around its middle, holding two giant knitting needles like swords.
characters.attack: jabs forward with both giant knitting needles.
characters.recoil: bounces back, loose strands flying.

characters.name: Teapot Dragon
characters.look: a round, stubby dragon with a blue-and-white floral porcelain teapot body, little brown horns, a spout snout puffing a curl of steam, a curling blue tail and tiny wings.
characters.attack: spins and whips its heavy porcelain tail around in front of it.
characters.recoil: knocked back, wobbling, lid rattling.

characters.name: Soap Golem
characters.look: a lumpy humanoid golem of white and pale-blue soap bars with a happy face, a mint-green patch on its belly, foamy bubbles clinging all over it and huge foam-covered fists.
characters.attack: swings a giant soapy fist forward in a big slam.
characters.recoil: slips backward, squashed, bubbles popping.

characters.name: Mirror Shade
characters.look: a black shadow-creature with a spiky silhouette, glowing red eyes and a jagged grin, leaning out of an old wooden mirror frame on long arms ending in huge claws.
characters.attack: lunges forward, clawed fingers stretched wide.
characters.recoil: flung back, eyes narrowed, arms flailing.

characters.name: Gelatinous Cube
characters.look: a bright lime-green wobbly cube of jelly with a cute face, small bubbles inside and a puddle at its base, with one giant jagged block of jelly raised like a hammer.
characters.attack: hops forward and slams down in a big squash.
characters.recoil: squished sideways, wobbling.

characters.name: Living Topiary
characters.look: a bushy green unicorn-shaped topiary with a clipped leafy mane, a tufted tail, hedge-clipped hooves and a golden spiral horn grown long and sharp.
characters.attack: charges forward, horn lowered.
characters.recoil: knocked back, leaves scattering, horn dipping.

characters.name: Bookwyrm
characters.look: a serpentine worm made of stacked brown books with blank pages sticking out, a dragon-like head with big jaws and two antennae tipped with bright ribbon bookmarks.
characters.attack: lunges forward, jaws snapping, pages flapping.
characters.recoil: recoils back, coils bunched, pages ruffled.

characters.name: Soup Spirit
characters.look: a round, glossy, tomato-red soup spirit shaped like a bowl, with a happy face, tiny arms, a steam wisp on top and a green basil leaf, carrying an enormous silver ladle.
characters.attack: scoops the giant ladle forward.
characters.recoil: sloshes backward, steam puffing, ladle wobbling.

characters.name: Fungal Knight
characters.look: a small knight in a steel helmet under a big spotted orange-brown mushroom cap, with a green tunic, brown boots and a leaf-green shield, carrying an oversized sword with a mushroom for a pommel.
characters.attack: a forward sword slash, shield raised.
characters.recoil: stumbles backward, cap bobbing, shield sagging.

characters.name: Echo Knight
characters.look: a tall knight in sleek pale ice-white and light-blue armor, with long wavy white hair and a blank glowing face, holding two huge matching swords.
characters.attack: a wide double-sword slash forward.
characters.recoil: drifts backward, wavy hair streaming, swords crossed.

characters.name: Grumpy Cloud
characters.look: a small, round, dark-gray storm cloud with a deeply furrowed brow and an angry scowl, tiny yellow lightning bolts on its body, a patch of blue rain beneath it and two huge cloud fists.
characters.attack: drives a huge fist forward, lightning crackling on its body.
characters.recoil: puffs backward, squashed, rain pattering.

characters.name: Frog Paladin
characters.look: a sturdy green frog in dented silver plate armor with a brown cloak and a very long lance, its long red tongue stretched out in front.
characters.attack: charges forward, lance thrust ahead, tongue lashing out.
characters.recoil: knocked back, armor rattling, lance tilted.

characters.name: Candy Witch
characters.look: a gingerbread woman with brown skin and long dark licorice hair, mint-green, orange and yellow hard-candy gems, holding a giant swirly candy-cane staff.
characters.attack: swings the giant candy-cane staff down in front of her.
characters.recoil: knocked back, hair flying, staff tilting.

characters.name: Mimic
characters.look: a dark wooden treasure chest with gold bands and a golden lock, a wide toothy mouth with a long red tongue, two little eyes and stubby legs.
characters.attack: chomps forward, the lid thrown wide like huge jaws.
characters.recoil: bounced back, lid flapping, tongue lolling.

characters.name: Ink Elemental
characters.look: a black, glossy ink-blob ghost with round white eyes, a toothy grin and a wavy swirling tail, wielding a huge sharp quill like a spear.
characters.attack: jabs forward with the quill, tail whipping.
characters.recoil: splashes back, squashed, ink dripping off it.

characters.name: Cheese Golem
characters.look: a hulking yellow-orange cheese golem full of round holes, with a big head, a square jaw and two heavy fists.
characters.attack: slams a giant cheesy fist down.
characters.recoil: knocked back, a chunk crumbling off, eyes wide.

characters.name: Marble Sphinx
characters.look: a chubby cream-and-beige marble sphinx cub with a striped royal headdress, big brown eyes, a golden forehead ornament, a lion body and huge stone paws.
characters.attack: swipes forward with a big stone paw.
characters.recoil: knocked back, dust puffing, paws up.

characters.name: Mosaic Guardian
characters.look: a stout guardian built of tiny red, blue, orange and gold tiles, with a big crested helmet, round shoulders, a teal gem on its chest and a huge tile-covered hammer.
characters.attack: a big overhead hammer smash.
characters.recoil: rocks back, tiles loosened and rattling.

characters.name: Prism Beast
characters.look: a diamond-shaped crystal creature with vertical bands of red, orange, yellow, green and blue, a happy face, stubby teal legs and two giant crystal fists.
characters.attack: slams forward with a giant crystal fist.
characters.recoil: jolts back, eyes squeezed shut.

characters.name: Puzzle Golem
characters.look: a hulking, blocky golem built of interlocking jigsaw pieces in tan, rust and olive-green, with glowing cyan eyes and huge hands.
characters.attack: a huge overhead double-fist slam.
characters.recoil: knocked back, a few pieces popping loose.

characters.name: Bone Jelly
characters.look: a dome-shaped bright green slime with a skeleton suspended inside it, a big skull pressing out of the front and a puddle at its base.
characters.attack: oozes forward, a bony arm swinging out of the goo.
characters.recoil: squashed back, bones jiggling, skull rattling.

characters.name: Button Golem
characters.look: a lumpy tan cloth humanoid stitched with patches, with a head of mismatched multicolored buttons for eyes, a stringy thread beard and long needle fingers.
characters.attack: stabs forward with its needle fingers.
characters.recoil: falls back, stuffing poking out, buttons rattling.

characters.name: Werewolf
characters.look: a gray wolf-headed man in a dark suit, white shirt and tie, with fierce eyes, pointed ears, a toothy snarl and enormous clawed hands.
characters.attack: swipes forward with a huge clawed hand.
characters.recoil: staggers back, tie flapping, ears flat.

characters.name: Clockwork Knight
characters.look: a knight in bronze and silver armor with a red plume, a round gear on its chest, a round brass shield with a sunburst and an oversized brass sword.
characters.attack: a forward sword slash, shield held out.
characters.recoil: clanks backward, plume drooping.

characters.name: Crystaline Warrior
characters.look: a small warrior in pale ice-blue and cyan crystal armor with a spiked crystal helmet, a round crystal shield and a huge crystal sword.
characters.attack: a heavy sword slash forward, shield out.
characters.recoil: knocked back, shield sagging, helmet askew.

characters.name: Living Constellation
characters.look: a hooded warrior in deep-blue armor patterned with gold star shapes and linked dots, with glowing yellow eyes and a huge golden sword.
characters.attack: a huge forward sword sweep.
characters.recoil: knocked back, one arm flung out.

characters.name: Clockwork Phoenix
characters.look: a bird with orange-red feathers, teal metal plates, brass gears, a flame-like crest and huge wings, with giant talons.
characters.attack: swoops forward, wings flared and talons out.
characters.recoil: tumbles back, feathers loose, wings fluttering.

characters.name: Textile Titan
characters.look: a hulking, muscular giant sewn of tan fabric with red patchwork stripes, two horns and a snarl, holding a giant sewing needle like a sword.
characters.attack: a mighty forward needle thrust.
characters.recoil: staggers back, stitches straining, thread trailing.

characters.name: Vampire
characters.look: a pale woman with tall black hair, red eyes, big fangs, a huge ruffled collar and a crimson ball gown, flaring a long black cape lined in red.
characters.attack: lunges forward, fangs bared, cape flared wide.
characters.recoil: reels back, hand to her forehead, collar crumpled.

characters.name: Orchestra Elemental
characters.look: a horned figure in golden-orange armor assembled from brass horns, a cello and a keyboard, swinging a huge golden trumpet like a club.
characters.attack: a wide trumpet swing forward.
characters.recoil: staggers back, instruments clanging.

characters.name: Coral Colossus
characters.look: a hulking branching-coral golem in orange, teal, blue and yellow, with thick arms, small glowing eyes and a spiky coral crown.
characters.attack: slams down a huge coral-branch fist.
characters.recoil: knocked back, a few branches snapping.

characters.name: Troll
characters.look: a hulking, round gray stone troll with a big head, two tusks, a glowing yellow eye and mossy shoulders, holding a boulder-sized club.
characters.attack: a heavy overhead smash.
characters.recoil: knocked back, fists drooping.

characters.name: Paradox Sphinx
characters.look: a winged sphinx of bronze and gold with a royal headdress, a lion body, big spread feathered wings and huge talons.
characters.attack: pounces forward, wings flared.
characters.recoil: reels back, wings fluttering, head shaking.

characters.name: Dozing Drake
characters.look: a round green dragon curled up asleep with closed eyes, folded wings, flames puffing from its snout and a huge heavy tail.
characters.attack: a lazy big tail swing forward, still asleep.
characters.recoil: rolled back, snoring, a puff of flame.

characters.name: Library Leviathan
characters.look: a hulking whale-shaped beast built of stacked books, with a tiny tower on its back and a huge mouth.
characters.attack: lunges forward, huge jaws open.
characters.recoil: bounces back, books loosened.

characters.name: Bureaucracy Demon
characters.look: a bald, red-horned demon in a torn gray suit with a red tie and a fanged scowl, carrying a giant fountain pen like a spear.
characters.attack: a downward stab with the huge pen.
characters.recoil: reels back, tie flapping.

characters.name: Storm Sovereign
characters.look: a regal figure of pale-blue lightning and crackling energy, with branching antlers, glowing cyan eyes and a towering crown.
characters.attack: a huge forward sweep of both crackling hands.
characters.recoil: jolted back, crackling.

characters.name: Beholder
characters.look: a round teal-green monster with a huge central eye, six smaller eyestalks, a wide fanged grin and a big mouth.
characters.attack: lunges forward, eyestalks stretching.
characters.recoil: knocked back, eyestalks wobbling.

characters.name: Quantum Dragon
characters.look: a slender silver-blue dragon with cyan-lit wings, shimmering scales, long horns, a curling tail and huge claws.
characters.attack: dives forward with claws out.
characters.recoil: knocked back, wings flickering.

characters.name: Recursion Wyrm
characters.look: a brown-and-gold dragon with copper wings and green wing tips, small dragon heads sprouting from its body, and huge claws.
characters.attack: lunges forward, claws out.
characters.recoil: reels back, wings drooping.
